senses.gloss:
चेद् चेद्, i. e. च-इद्, a particle.
 1. Even, MBh. 1, 2403.
 2. If, Man. 7, 25.
 3. With preceding नो it forms usually a short sentence, which must be completed by the preceding words, e. g. भवता मौनव्रतेन स्थातव्यम् नो चेत् तव काष्ठात् पातो भविष्यति, You must be silent, if not you will fall from the stick, Pañc. 76, 20.
 4. With preceding न sometimes, That not, Rām. 5, 80, 24.
 5. With preceding इति and following न, viz. इति चेन् न, a common form of concluding an opponent's objection, and proceeding to answer it.
 --Cf. probably वै᳓.
चेदि चेदि, m. pl. The name of a people, Nal. 6, 7.
